controles.affirmation: Taux de retention des polices descendu a 88,4 %, en baisse de 2,0 points
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The Exchange and its wholly owned property and casualty insurance subsidiaries' year-over-year policy retention ratio was 87.5% at June 30, 2026 and 88.4% at December 31, 2025." 10-Q T2 2025 : "...policy retention ratio continues to be high at 89.7% at June 30, 2025 and 90.4% at December 31, 2024."
controles.correction_proposee: 88,4 % est la valeur au 31 decembre 2025, pas la valeur courante. Au 30 juin 2026 le taux de retention est de 87,5 %, contre 89,7 % un an plus tot, soit -2,2 points. Ecrire : "le taux de retention des polices est descendu a 87,5 % au 30 juin 2026, contre 89,7 % un an plus tot (-2,2 points)". Les deux autres indicateurs du meme bloc (PIF et prime moyenne) sont bien des donnees du T2 2026 : les melanger avec une donnee de fin 2025 induit le lecteur en erreur.

controles.affirmation: Preuve citee entre guillemets : "we may retain up to 25% of all direct and affiliated assumed premiums written by the Exchange" et "The management fee rate is set at least annually by our Board of Directors and may not exceed 25%"
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune de ces deux phrases n'existe telle quelle dans le 10-Q T2 2026. Le document dit : "In accordance with the subscriber's agreement, we retain a management fee calculated as a percentage, not to exceed 25%, of all direct and affiliated assumed written premiums of the Exchange." et "The management fee is calculated by multiplying all direct and affiliated assumed premiums written by the Exchange by the management fee rate, which is set by our Board of Directors at least annually. The management fee rate was set at 25% for both 2026 and 2025."
controles.correction_proposee: Le FOND de l'affirmation (plafond contractuel de 25 %, taux fixe a 25 % pour 2026 et 2025, taux arrete au moins une fois par an par le conseil) est exact. Mais les guillemets presentent une paraphrase comme un verbatim. Remplacer par les deux citations reelles ci-dessus.

controles.affirmation: Polices en portefeuille -2,0 % sur un an, degradation de 3,7 points ; prime moyenne +6,8 %, ralentissement de 5,1 points
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The year-over-year average premium per policy for all lines of business increased 6.8% at June 30, 2026 compared to 11.9% at June 30, 2025. Year-over-year policies in force for all lines of business decreased 2.0% in the second quarter of 2026 compared to an increase 1.7% in the second quarter of 2025." (-2,0 % contre +1,7 % = 3,7 points ; 6,8 % contre 11,9 % = 5,1 points).

controles.affirmation: Cout des services d'emission et de renouvellement +5,5 % a 684,1 M$ contre des frais de gestion associes +4,7 % a 862,9 M$
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Management fee revenue for policy issuance and renewal services increased 4.7% to $862.9 million in the second quarter of 2026" ; "Cost of operations for policy issuance and renewal services increased 5.5% to $684.1 million in the second quarter of 2026... primarily due to increased agent incentive compensation due to improved profitability and higher scheduled commissions driven by direct and affiliated assumed written premium growth". Compte de resultat : 684 119 contre 648 280 (+5,53 %).

controles.affirmation: Primes directes et affiliees souscrites par l'Exchange +3,3 % au T2 2026 et +3,4 % sur le semestre ; chiffre d'affaires total d'Indemnity +2,8 %
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The direct and affiliated assumed premiums written by the Exchange increased 3.3% to $3.5 billion in the second quarter of 2026 and 3.4% to $6.8 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2026." Compte de resultat : "Total operating revenue 1,089,796" contre "1,060,097" = +2,80 %.

controles.affirmation: Dividende classe A 1,4625 $/action (+7,1 %) contre resultat net 180,3 M$ (+3,2 %) ; aucun rachat d'actions au T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, etat des capitaux propres : "Dividends declared: Class A $1.4625 per share" ; "Net income 180,294" contre 174,685 au T2 2025 (+3,21 %) ; "Net purchase of treasury stock 0". 10-Q T2 2025 : "Class A $1.365 per share" (1,4625/1,365 = +7,14 %).

controles.affirmation: Dependance totale a un client unique ; risque de catastrophe concentree ; concurrence par l'IA sur la souscription
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 1A : "...with the Exchange as our sole customer, we are dependent on the financial condition of the Exchange" ; "the Exchange is our sole customer and principal source of revenue" ; "If an extreme catastrophic event were to occur in a heavily concentrated geographic area of subscribers (policyholders), an extraordinarily high number of claims could have the potential to strain claims processing" ; "Innovations, including the use of artificial intelligence and machine learning to support underwriting or other decisions, by competitors or other market participants may increase the level of competition in the industry." La mention "tendance a la hausse" correspond bien au champ interne trend=up de src/data/v2-pipeline/erie.json, et l'ATT la presente explicitement comme une donnee interne.

controles.affirmation: Marge d'exploitation stable autour de 19 %, bilan sans dette long terme
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Operating income 204,123" sur "Total operating revenue 1,089,796" = 18,7 % (T2 2025 : 199 173 / 1 060 097 = 18,8 %). Le bilan consolide ne comporte aucune ligne d'emprunt ou de dette long terme.
